targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM analytics_analytics.daily_sales_summary
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics_marts.fct_orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
SELECT order_date AS time, revenue FROM analytics_analytics.daily_sales_summary ORDER BY order_date
SELECT category, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM analytics_analytics.monthly_revenue_by_category GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT customer_id, first_name || ' ' || last_name AS customer, lifetime_value FROM analytics_analytics.customer_ltv ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units_sold),0) AS units FROM analytics_analytics.daily_sales_summary
